simple.meaning: כַּחַשׁ (kachash) is a Hebrew word meaning “literally a failure of flesh , i.e. emaciation ; figuratively, hypocrisy.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: כַּחַשׁ (H3585) appears 6 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Job 16:8, with occurrences in Job, Psalms, Hosea, Nahum.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to כַּחַשׁ (H3585) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in כַּחַשׁ (H3585) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: כַּחַשׁ (kachash) / H3585 is traced through Job 16:8, Psalms 59:13, Hosea 7:3, Hosea 10:13 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.short: literally a failure of flesh , i.e. emaciation ; figuratively, hypocrisy
definitions.full: H3585. kachash כַּ֫חַשׁ noun masculine Job 16:8 1 lying . 2 leanness ; — absolute ׳כ Hosea 12:1-2 t.; כָּ֑חַשׁ 10:13 ; suffix כַּחֲשִׁי Job 16:8 ; plural suffix כַּחֲשֵׁיהֶם Hosea 7:3 ; — 1 lying , כ ׳מְּרִי אֲכַלְתֶּם Hosea 10:13 ye have eaten the fruit of lying ; 7:3 (|| רָעָה ), 12:1 ; of Nineveh, ׳כ מְלֵאָה מֶּרֶק Nahum 3:1 of lying (and) robbery it is full ; Psa 59:13 (|| אָלָה ). 2 of Job's affliction Job 16:8 my leanness hath risen up against me (compare Psa 109:24 ; ᵑ7 J Gen 41:27 ; Eccl 12:5 ; Talmud כחשׁא ; > my lying , i.e. my affliction regarded as a lying witness, Di Buhl and others)

occurrences.englishText: You have shriveled me up. This is a witness against me.
They make the king glad with their wickedness,
Woe to the bloody city! It is all full of lies and robbery. The prey doesn’t depart.
